approval_requests_decision_is_complete.name: approval_requests_decision_is_complete
approval_requests_decision_is_complete.value:
("approvals"."approval_requests"."status" = 'pending' and "approvals"."approval_requests"."decided_by" is null and "approvals"."approval_requests"."decided_at" is null)
          or ("approvals"."approval_requests"."status" = 'cancelled' and "approvals"."approval_requests"."decided_by" is null)
          or ("approvals"."approval_requests"."status"::text = 'auto_approved' and "approvals"."approval_requests"."decided_by" is null and "approvals"."approval_requests"."decided_at" is not null)
          or ("approvals"."approval_requests"."status" in ('approved', 'rejected') and "approvals"."approval_requests"."decided_by" is not null and "approvals"."approval_requests"."decided_at" is not null)

consignments_booked_has_number.name: consignments_booked_has_number
consignments_booked_has_number.value: "courier"."consignments"."booking_state" <> 'booked' or ("courier"."consignments"."consignment_no" is not null and "courier"."consignments"."booked_at" is not null)

courier_accounts_active_has_credentials.name: courier_accounts_active_has_credentials
courier_accounts_active_has_credentials.value: "courier"."courier_accounts"."is_active" = false or "courier"."courier_accounts"."credentials" is not null or "courier"."courier_accounts"."provider_code" = 'fake'

selection_rules_cod_not_negative.name: selection_rules_cod_not_negative
selection_rules_cod_not_negative.value: ("courier"."selection_rules"."min_cod_poisha" is null or "courier"."selection_rules"."min_cod_poisha" >= 0) and ("courier"."selection_rules"."max_cod_poisha" is null or "courier"."selection_rules"."max_cod_poisha" >= 0)

selection_rules_cod_band_ordered.name: selection_rules_cod_band_ordered
selection_rules_cod_band_ordered.value: "courier"."selection_rules"."min_cod_poisha" is null or "courier"."selection_rules"."max_cod_poisha" is null or "courier"."selection_rules"."min_cod_poisha" <= "courier"."selection_rules"."max_cod_poisha"

settlement_lines_matched_has_consignment.name: settlement_lines_matched_has_consignment
settlement_lines_matched_has_consignment.value: "courier"."settlement_lines"."match" <> 'matched' or ("courier"."settlement_lines"."consignment_id" is not null and "courier"."settlement_lines"."order_id" is not null)

settlements_posted_has_journal.name: settlements_posted_has_journal
settlements_posted_has_journal.value:
"courier"."settlements"."status" <> 'posted'
          or ("courier"."settlements"."posted_at" is not null
              and "courier"."settlements"."posting_business_date" is not null
              and ("courier"."settlements"."charges_journal_id" is not null or "courier"."settlements"."cash_journal_id" is not null))

customer_segments_scores.name: customer_segments_scores
customer_segments_scores.value: "sales"."customer_segments"."recency" between 0 and 5 and "sales"."customer_segments"."frequency" between 0 and 5 and "sales"."customer_segments"."monetary" between 0 and 5

file_objects_stored_is_complete.name: file_objects_stored_is_complete
file_objects_stored_is_complete.value:
("files"."objects"."status" = 'pending' and "files"."objects"."sha256" is null and "files"."objects"."size_bytes" is null)
       or ("files"."objects"."status" = 'stored'
           and "files"."objects"."sha256" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
           and "files"."objects"."size_bytes" is not null
           and "files"."objects"."size_bytes" > 0
           and "files"."objects"."size_bytes" <= 104857600)

attendance_days_times_ordered.name: attendance_days_times_ordered
attendance_days_times_ordered.value:
"hr"."attendance_days"."check_in_at" is null or "hr"."attendance_days"."check_out_at" is null
          or "hr"."attendance_days"."check_out_at" >= "hr"."attendance_days"."check_in_at"

employee_loans_disbursed_has_journal.name: employee_loans_disbursed_has_journal
employee_loans_disbursed_has_journal.value:
case "hr"."employee_loans"."status"
            when 'pending_disbursement' then "hr"."employee_loans"."journal_id" is null
            else "hr"."employee_loans"."journal_id" is not null and "hr"."employee_loans"."disbursed_on" is not null
          end

loan_instalments_status_matches_deducted.name: loan_instalments_status_matches_deducted
loan_instalments_status_matches_deducted.value:
case "hr"."loan_instalments"."status"
            when 'due' then "hr"."loan_instalments"."deducted_poisha" = 0
            when 'partly_deducted' then "hr"."loan_instalments"."deducted_poisha" > 0 and "hr"."loan_instalments"."deducted_poisha" < "hr"."loan_instalments"."amount_poisha"
            when 'deducted' then "hr"."loan_instalments"."deducted_poisha" = "hr"."loan_instalments"."amount_poisha"
            else true
          end

payroll_lines_amounts_not_negative.name: payroll_lines_amounts_not_negative
payroll_lines_amounts_not_negative.value:
"hr"."payroll_lines"."basic_poisha" > 0 and "hr"."payroll_lines"."allowances_poisha" >= 0
          and "hr"."payroll_lines"."bonus_poisha" >= 0 and "hr"."payroll_lines"."gross_poisha" > 0
          and "hr"."payroll_lines"."absence_deduction_poisha" >= 0 and "hr"."payroll_lines"."fixed_deduction_poisha" >= 0
          and "hr"."payroll_lines"."other_deduction_poisha" >= 0 and "hr"."payroll_lines"."loan_deduction_poisha" >= 0
          and "hr"."payroll_lines"."loan_shortfall_poisha" >= 0
          and "hr"."payroll_lines"."deductions_poisha" >= 0 and "hr"."payroll_lines"."net_poisha" >= 0

payroll_lines_days_sane.name: payroll_lines_days_sane
payroll_lines_days_sane.value:
"hr"."payroll_lines"."working_days" >= 0 and "hr"."payroll_lines"."present_days" >= 0 and "hr"."payroll_lines"."absent_days" >= 0
          and "hr"."payroll_lines"."half_days" >= 0 and "hr"."payroll_lines"."paid_leave_days" >= 0 and "hr"."payroll_lines"."unrecorded_days" >= 0
          and "hr"."payroll_lines"."present_days" + "hr"."payroll_lines"."absent_days" + "hr"."payroll_lines"."half_days"
              + "hr"."payroll_lines"."paid_leave_days" <= "hr"."payroll_lines"."working_days"

payroll_runs_status_links.name: payroll_runs_status_links
payroll_runs_status_links.value:
case "hr"."payroll_runs"."status"
            when 'draft' then "hr"."payroll_runs"."approval_request_id" is null and "hr"."payroll_runs"."journal_id" is null
              and "hr"."payroll_runs"."payment_journal_id" is null
            when 'pending_approval' then "hr"."payroll_runs"."approval_request_id" is not null
              and "hr"."payroll_runs"."journal_id" is null and "hr"."payroll_runs"."payment_journal_id" is null
            when 'posted' then "hr"."payroll_runs"."approval_request_id" is not null
              and "hr"."payroll_runs"."journal_id" is not null and "hr"."payroll_runs"."posted_on" is not null
              and "hr"."payroll_runs"."payment_journal_id" is null
            when 'paid' then "hr"."payroll_runs"."approval_request_id" is not null
              and "hr"."payroll_runs"."journal_id" is not null
              and "hr"."payroll_runs"."payment_journal_id" is not null and "hr"."payroll_runs"."paid_on" is not null
              and "hr"."payroll_runs"."paid_from_account_id" is not null
            else "hr"."payroll_runs"."journal_id" is null and "hr"."payroll_runs"."payment_journal_id" is null
          end

idempotency_keys_completion_consistent.name: idempotency_keys_completion_consistent
idempotency_keys_completion_consistent.value:
("http"."idempotency_keys"."completed_at" is null and "http"."idempotency_keys"."status_code" is null)
        or ("http"."idempotency_keys"."completed_at" is not null and "http"."idempotency_keys"."status_code" is not null)

submissions_completed_has_order.name: submissions_completed_has_order
submissions_completed_has_order.value: ("intake"."submissions"."status" = 'completed') = ("intake"."submissions"."order_id" is not null and "intake"."submissions"."completed_at" is not null)

adjustments_status_journal.name: adjustments_status_journal
adjustments_status_journal.value:
case "inventory"."adjustments"."status"
            when 'posted' then "inventory"."adjustments"."journal_id" is not null and "inventory"."adjustments"."approval_request_id" is not null
            when 'pending_approval' then "inventory"."adjustments"."journal_id" is null and "inventory"."adjustments"."approval_request_id" is not null
            else "inventory"."adjustments"."journal_id" is null
          end

stock_movements_sign_matches_kind.name: stock_movements_sign_matches_kind
stock_movements_sign_matches_kind.value:
("inventory"."stock_movements"."kind"::text in ('opening_balance', 'supply_receipt', 'customer_return', 'pos_return', 'transfer_in', 'adjustment_gain') and "inventory"."stock_movements"."qty_delta" > 0)
          or ("inventory"."stock_movements"."kind"::text in ('supplier_return', 'dispatch', 'pos_sale', 'transfer_out', 'adjustment_loss') and "inventory"."stock_movements"."qty_delta" < 0)
          or ("inventory"."stock_movements"."kind"::text = 'count_correction' and "inventory"."stock_movements"."qty_delta" <> 0)

stock_transfers_received_is_complete.name: stock_transfers_received_is_complete
stock_transfers_received_is_complete.value:
("inventory"."stock_transfers"."status" = 'received' and "inventory"."stock_transfers"."received_at" is not null and "inventory"."stock_transfers"."received_by" is not null)
          or ("inventory"."stock_transfers"."status" <> 'received' and "inventory"."stock_transfers"."received_at" is null and "inventory"."stock_transfers"."received_by" is null)

distributions_status_journal.name: distributions_status_journal
distributions_status_journal.value:
case "investors"."distributions"."status"
            when 'declared' then "investors"."distributions"."journal_id" is not null and "investors"."distributions"."declared_on" is not null
            when 'pending_approval' then "investors"."distributions"."journal_id" is null and "investors"."distributions"."approval_request_id" is not null
            else "investors"."distributions"."journal_id" is null
          end

withdrawals_status_shape.name: withdrawals_status_shape
withdrawals_status_shape.value:
case "investors"."withdrawals"."status"
            when 'requested' then "investors"."withdrawals"."reviewed_by" is null and "investors"."withdrawals"."approval_request_id" is null
                 and "investors"."withdrawals"."journal_id" is null and "investors"."withdrawals"."paid_on" is null
            when 'reviewed' then "investors"."withdrawals"."reviewed_by" is not null and "investors"."withdrawals"."wallet_account_id" is not null
                 and "investors"."withdrawals"."approval_request_id" is not null and "investors"."withdrawals"."journal_id" is null
            when 'approved' then "investors"."withdrawals"."reviewed_by" is not null and "investors"."withdrawals"."wallet_account_id" is not null
                 and "investors"."withdrawals"."approval_request_id" is not null and "investors"."withdrawals"."journal_id" is null
            when 'paid' then "investors"."withdrawals"."journal_id" is not null and "investors"."withdrawals"."paid_on" is not null
                 and "investors"."withdrawals"."paid_by" is not null and "investors"."withdrawals"."wallet_account_id" is not null
            else "investors"."withdrawals"."journal_id" is null
          end

periods_whole_month.name: periods_whole_month
periods_whole_month.value:
extract(day from "ledger"."periods"."starts_on") = 1
          and "ledger"."periods"."ends_on" = ("ledger"."periods"."starts_on" + interval '1 month' - interval '1 day')::date

periods_closed_has_closer.name: periods_closed_has_closer
periods_closed_has_closer.value: "ledger"."periods"."status" <> 'closed' or ("ledger"."periods"."closed_at" is not null and "ledger"."periods"."closed_by" is not null)

migration_batches_decided_whole.name: migration_batches_decided_whole
migration_batches_decided_whole.value:
("migration"."batches"."decided_by" is null) = ("migration"."batches"."decided_at" is null)
        and (("migration"."batches"."status" in ('discarded', 'posted')) = ("migration"."batches"."decided_at" is not null))

notify_templates_bodies.name: notify_templates_bodies
notify_templates_bodies.value: length("notify"."templates"."body_bn") between 1 and 1000 and length("notify"."templates"."body_en") between 1 and 1000

pos_returns_status_shape.name: pos_returns_status_shape
pos_returns_status_shape.value:
case "pos"."returns"."status"
            when 'posted' then "pos"."returns"."posted_on" is not null and "pos"."returns"."cogs_poisha" is not null
                 and ("pos"."returns"."journal_id" is not null or ("pos"."returns"."refund_poisha" = 0 and "pos"."returns"."cogs_poisha" = 0))
            when 'held' then "pos"."returns"."journal_id" is null and "pos"."returns"."posted_on" is null
            else "pos"."returns"."journal_id" is null and "pos"."returns"."void_reason" is not null and "pos"."returns"."voided_by" is not null
          end

pos_review_items_document.name: pos_review_items_document
pos_review_items_document.value:
("pos"."review_items"."kind" = 'sale' and "pos"."review_items"."sale_id" is not null and "pos"."review_items"."return_id" is null)
          or ("pos"."review_items"."kind" = 'return' and "pos"."review_items"."return_id" is not null and "pos"."review_items"."sale_id" is null)

pos_sale_tenders_reference_length.name: pos_sale_tenders_reference_length
pos_sale_tenders_reference_length.value: "pos"."sale_tenders"."reference" is null or length("pos"."sale_tenders"."reference") between 1 and 40

pos_sales_status_shape.name: pos_sales_status_shape
pos_sales_status_shape.value:
case "pos"."sales"."status"
            when 'posted' then "pos"."sales"."posted_on" is not null and "pos"."sales"."cogs_poisha" is not null
                 and ("pos"."sales"."journal_id" is not null or ("pos"."sales"."net_poisha" = 0 and "pos"."sales"."cogs_poisha" = 0))
            when 'held' then "pos"."sales"."journal_id" is null and "pos"."sales"."posted_on" is null
            else "pos"."sales"."journal_id" is null and "pos"."sales"."void_reason" is not null and "pos"."sales"."voided_by" is not null
          end

pos_shifts_close_shape.name: pos_shifts_close_shape
pos_shifts_close_shape.value:
case "pos"."shifts"."status"
            when 'open' then "pos"."shifts"."closed_at" is null and "pos"."shifts"."closed_by" is null
                 and "pos"."shifts"."counted_cash_poisha" is null and "pos"."shifts"."variance_poisha" is null
            else "pos"."shifts"."closed_at" is not null and "pos"."shifts"."closed_by" is not null
                 and "pos"."shifts"."counted_cash_poisha" >= 0 and "pos"."shifts"."expected_cash_poisha" is not null
                 and "pos"."shifts"."variance_poisha" = "pos"."shifts"."counted_cash_poisha" - "pos"."shifts"."expected_cash_poisha"
          end

promo_codes_value.name: promo_codes_value
promo_codes_value.value:
("promo"."codes"."kind" = 'percent' and "promo"."codes"."value_bps" between 1 and 10000)
        or ("promo"."codes"."kind" = 'flat' and "promo"."codes"."value_poisha" > 0)
        or "promo"."codes"."kind" = 'free_delivery'

promo_codes_amounts.name: promo_codes_amounts
promo_codes_amounts.value:
("promo"."codes"."min_order_poisha" is null or "promo"."codes"."min_order_poisha" >= 0)
        and ("promo"."codes"."max_discount_poisha" is null or "promo"."codes"."max_discount_poisha" > 0)

promo_codes_limits.name: promo_codes_limits
promo_codes_limits.value:
("promo"."codes"."total_limit" is null or "promo"."codes"."total_limit" > 0)
        and ("promo"."codes"."per_customer_limit" is null or "promo"."codes"."per_customer_limit" > 0)

promo_codes_window.name: promo_codes_window
promo_codes_window.value: "promo"."codes"."valid_from" is null or "promo"."codes"."valid_to" is null or "promo"."codes"."valid_from" <= "promo"."codes"."valid_to"

supplier_payments_status_journal.name: supplier_payments_status_journal
supplier_payments_status_journal.value:
case "supply"."supplier_payments"."status"
            when 'posted' then "supply"."supplier_payments"."journal_id" is not null
            when 'pending_approval' then "supply"."supplier_payments"."journal_id" is null and "supply"."supplier_payments"."approval_request_id" is not null
            else "supply"."supplier_payments"."journal_id" is null
          end

supplies_org_supplier_invoice_idx.name: supplies_org_supplier_invoice_idx
supplies_org_supplier_invoice_idx.where: status = 'received' and invoice_number is not null

supplies_status_journal.name: supplies_status_journal
supplies_status_journal.value:
case "supply"."supplies"."status"
            when 'received' then "supply"."supplies"."journal_id" is not null and "supply"."supplies"."occurred_at" is not null
                 and "supply"."supplies"."business_date" is not null and "supply"."supplies"."received_by" is not null
            else "supply"."supplies"."journal_id" is null and "supply"."supplies"."received_by" is null
          end

cash_entries_status_journal.name: cash_entries_status_journal
cash_entries_status_journal.value:
case "wallets"."cash_entries"."status"
            when 'posted' then "wallets"."cash_entries"."journal_id" is not null
            when 'pending_approval' then "wallets"."cash_entries"."journal_id" is null and "wallets"."cash_entries"."approval_request_id" is not null
            else "wallets"."cash_entries"."journal_id" is null
          end

wallets_provider_length.name: wallets_provider_length
wallets_provider_length.value: "wallets"."wallets"."provider" is null or length("wallets"."wallets"."provider") between 1 and 80

wallet_closings_status_shape.name: wallet_closings_status_shape
wallet_closings_status_shape.value:
case "wallets"."closings"."status"
            when 'balanced' then "wallets"."closings"."variance_poisha" = 0 and "wallets"."closings"."journal_id" is null
            when 'posted' then "wallets"."closings"."variance_poisha" <> 0 and "wallets"."closings"."journal_id" is not null
            when 'pending_approval' then "wallets"."closings"."variance_poisha" <> 0 and "wallets"."closings"."journal_id" is null
                 and "wallets"."closings"."approval_request_id" is not null
            else "wallets"."closings"."journal_id" is null
          end
